purpose:
Verify frozen C37 using cosim in a new workspace. Run four complete load/reuse/reload/retain transactions with finite-FIFO profiling and deadlock detection; measure actual latency and interval under a six-hour timeout.

Decision basis: C37 passes complete13-image E065 exactness,unchanged border and deltaPSNR,allthreefoldII1,and HLS screening at1032DSP/128942LUT/194250FF; register_evidence.json verifies all224parameter data bits before bank writes,latency1/II1. Independently check four transactions under matching C35 upper-only+1percent bounds. Run after active corrected-thread W36 without sharing the heavy slot. Run load/reuse/reload/latest-bank retention as four complete transactions. Butterfly and ignored-pointer lenna must be E065-exact; constructed loaded and retained outputs must equal104/256 everywhere. Require zero parameter AXI valid cycles and handshakes on both skipped calls and no parameter writes. Each skipped-call latency must not exceed its corresponding loaded call. Each transaction must independently remain <=its matching C35 latency*101//100: [275755, 269692, 275755, 269692]. Faster calls have no lower bound.
